scripts.electron:wait-and-start: wait-on tcp:5173 dist-electron/main.js && npm run electron:start
scripts.electron:dev: node scripts/write-electron-package-json.mjs && concurrently -k -n VITE,TSC,ELECTRON -c blue,yellow,green "npm:dev" "tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json --watch" "npm:electron:wait-and-start"
scripts.electron:package: npm run build && npm run electron:build && cross-env NODE_ENV=production electron .
